<thought>The observed isotopic pattern shows a dominant peak at m/z 141 with a ~9 % M+1 peak, a ~0.6 % M+2 peak, and rapidly decreasing higher‑mass peaks. This matches the natural 13C abundance (~1.1 % per carbon) for a molecule containing several carbons, while characteristic patterns of Cl, Br, S, etc., are absent. Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified from the isotope distribution.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
